title: Funded escrow-capped batch ingestion for a large region via packages/runner
context: When a priority region is too large to ingest incrementally with donated compute alone, the project may use the Elyos funded lane (packages/runner, Anthropic API key in runner env only) for a one-time escrow-capped batch ingestion run. The funded lane has a hard per-task budget cap enforced by the runner; the API key must never appear in logs, receipts, or committed files. The funded lane is optional and backlog; it activates only when a partner is secured and the region/budget are defined. The $25 cap is a placeholder — the actual cap must be set and approved by the steward before activation.
objective: Using packages/runner under a hard per-task escrow cap, perform a large-scale batch ingestion of food-assistance entries for one priority region identified by the named partner. The run must: stay within the fundedBudgetUsd cap; produce entries that clear the same provenance + verification + license + PII gates as the donated-lane pipeline; keep the API key only in the runner environment (never logged, never committed); and hand off a staged dataset for human verification and the standard CI gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Run uses packages/runner with a hard fundedBudgetUsd cap; the run aborts if the cap would be exceeded
API key is present only in the runner environment variable; it does not appear in any log, receipt, git commit, or CI artifact
All ingested entries are staged for human review — the batch does not bypass the verification gate or self-certify human-required verification methods
Entries produced follow the same schema and provenance requirements as the donated-lane pipeline
A cost receipt (total tokens, total spend) is recorded in the verification log alongside the PR, but contains no secrets
The batch output is reviewed and approved by a human reviewer before merging to the authoritative dataset
The fundedBudgetUsd cap and the steward's approval of the budget are documented before the task is activated
Funded lane activation is gated on: a named partner (food-maps-partner-016 complete) and a defined region and budget approved by the steward
output: data/<region>/batch-staged/ (staged batch entries awaiting human verification review) + a cost receipt in docs/verification-log.md.
